LanguageData.ZoologyCannotDraftDuringRitual: Animals cannot be drafted during rituals.
LanguageData.Zoology_ResetMessage: Settings have been reset to defaults.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePreyFleeing_Desc: Animals will try to flee from nearby predators.
LanguageData.Zoology_FleeDistanceTargetPredator_Label: Flee distance from target predator: {0} (min {1}, max {2})
LanguageData.Zoology_AnimalsFlee_NonHostile_Desc: Animals will also flee from predators that are not currently hostile.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePackHunt_Desc: Pack-hunting predators can coordinate their attacks on prey.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAdvancedPredation_Desc: Predators stalk prey and select targets according to their vulnerability and accessibility.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableScavengering_Desc: Animals with scavenging behavior may feed on corpses.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePredatorDefendCorpse_Desc: Predators may defend corpses they are feeding on.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePredatorDefendFromHumans_L: Allow predators to defend prey from humans and mechanoids
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePredatorDefendFromHumans_D: Predators may attack humans or mechanoids that threaten their prey.
LanguageData.Zoology_MinCombatPowerDefend_Label: Minimum combat power to defend prey: {0} (min {1}, max {2})
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableMammalLactation_Desc: Mammal mothers produce milk and nurse their young.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableHandlerBabyFeeding_Label: Allow handlers to feed baby mammals
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableHandlerBabyFeeding_Desc: Handlers feed hungry mammal infants that cannot yet eat adult food. Requires mammal lactation.
LanguageData.Zoology_AllowSlaughterLactating_Desc: Allows animals that are currently lactating to be marked for slaughter.
LanguageData.Zoology_LactationDisabled_Note: Lactation is disabled, so this option is unavailable.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalChildcare_Desc: Adults of suitable species care for and protect their young.
LanguageData.Zoology_MinCombatPowerDefendYoung_Label: Minimum combat power to defend young and clutches from humans/mechanoids: {0} (min {1}, max {2})
LanguageData.Zoology_PreventFleeFromHumansWhileProtec: Do not flee from humans while protecting young
Animals strong enough to defend their young from humans and mechanoids will not flee while they have protectable young.
Do not flee from humans while protecting clutches
Animals strong enough to defend their clutch from humans and mechanoids will not flee while they have a protectable clutch.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalEggProtection_Desc: Adults of suitable species defend their nests and eggs.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalWoundLicking_Desc: Animals lick bleeding surface wounds to aid recovery. Colony animals do so when their medical care is set to No medical care.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableEctothermic_Desc: Ectothermic animals seek suitable places to regulate their body temperature.
LanguageData.Zoology_DynamicAnimalGrowth_Desc: Young animals gradually change in size and abilities as they mature.
LanguageData.Zoology_CENotAvailable: Zoology's animal damage reduction is disabled while Combat Extended is active.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalDraftControl_Desc: Allow animals to be drafted manually.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalDamageReduction_Desc: Adjust damage from natural attacks according to the animals' relative body sizes.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableCustomFleeDanger_Desc: Animals take body-size thresholds into account when deciding whether to flee.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableIgnoreSmallPets_Desc: Raiders may ignore the smallest domestic animals.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableSmallPetNoMelee_Label: Small pets do not retaliate in melee
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableSmallPetNoMelee_Desc: Very small pets will not use melee retaliation.
LanguageData.Zoology_AnimalsFreeFromHumans_Desc: Selected animal species flee from nearby humans.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableWildAnimalReproduction_Des: Wild animals breed naturally, increasing their populations.
LanguageData.Zoology_LimitWildAnimalReproductionByEco: Pause wild-to-wild mating when the ecosystem is overloaded
Limits mating between wild animals when the biome reaches its configured wildlife capacity. Mating with faction animals is not affected.
LanguageData.Zoology_ForceWildAnimalsToLeaveOnEcosyst: Force wild animals to leave an overloaded ecosystem
When the local wildlife population exceeds its limit, animals of the most numerous species begin to leave the map.
LanguageData.Zoology_LimitWildAnimalsPerSpecies_Label: Limit wild animals of the same species on each map
LanguageData.Zoology_LimitWildAnimalsPerSpecies_Desc: Limits the number of wild animals of each species on a map. Excess animals leave with their dependent young.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableHumanBionicOnAnimal_Desc: Allow human bionics to be installed on animals where supported.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAgroAtSlaughter_Desc: Animals may become aggressive when marked for slaughter.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableCannotBeMutated_Desc: Protect selected animal species from biomutation effects.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableCannotBeAugmented_Desc: Prevent augmentation of selected animal species.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableNoFlee_Desc: Selected species do not flee danger or enter panic states.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableFleeFromCarrier_Desc: Selected animals avoid nearby carriers marked as threats.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableFlyingFleeStart_Desc: Flying animals may begin fleeing sooner.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableGenderRestrictedAttacks_De: Some attacks may be limited by gender.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableCannotChew_Desc: Restrict suitable animals from eating whole corpses or prey beyond their swallowing capacity.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAgeless_Desc: Protect selected animals from disease and age-related ailments.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableDrugsImmune_Desc: Protect selected animals from drug effects and addiction.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalClotting_Desc: Suitable animals can stop bleeding from their wounds without a handler.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableNoPorcupineQuill_Desc: Prevent porcupine-quill injuries in selected animals.
LanguageData.Zoology_MasterSwitchNote: These switches affect runtime patches and may require a reload.
LanguageData.Zoology_ReloadWarning: Some changes may require reloading the game.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableInsectCocoonSpawnFix_Desc: Fixes the emergence of insects from cocoons altered by other mods.
LanguageData.Zoology_Dialog_MoveAnimalToOppositeList: Click an animal to move it to the opposite list.
LanguageData.Zoology_Dialog_FleeHumans_Instruction: Click an animal to move it between species that flee from humans and those that do not.
LanguageData.Zoology_Dialog_Roamers_Instruction: Click an animal to change whether it roams. Roaming animals eventually leave the map and cannot be trained.
LanguageData.Zoology_RuntimeFeature_Ageless_Disabled: Not resistant to disease and aging
LanguageData.Zoology_RuntimeFeature_AnimalClotting_Di: Do not treat their own wounds
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePetPlay_Desc: Colonists walk dogs and play with suitable pets, throwing toys for them to chase.
LanguageData.Zoology_ExpandedBondingNone_Desc: Keep the game's normal animal bonding rules.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnablePetBonding_Desc: Pets can form bonds with colonists regardless of trainability, including through play and nuzzling.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalBonding_Desc: Animals can form bonds with colonists regardless of trainability, including through play and nuzzling.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableRaidAnimals_Desc: More animal species may accompany groups of people from other factions.
LanguageData.Zoology_OrphanedRaidAnimalsBecomeWild_De: Animals that lose their handler and cannot be reassigned may become wild instead of fleeing the map.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalBarn_Desc: Build livestock barns to house animals and store feed. Disabling barns unloads their animals and food.
LanguageData.Zoology_BarnNoEligible: No suitable tame roaming animals on this map
LanguageData.Zoology_BarnManualLoadDesc: Order a handler to lead an animal into this barn. Requires free space and overrides the barn's animal filter and pen preference.
LanguageData.Zoology_BarnCancelManualLoadDesc: Cancel pending orders to lead animals into this barn.
LanguageData.Zoology_HideBarnAnimalsFromAnimalTab_Lab: Hide barn animals in Animals tab
LanguageData.Zoology_HideBarnAnimalsFromAnimalTab_Des: Hide animals inside barns from the Animals management tab.
LanguageData.Zoology_AutomaticJuvenileSpriteScaling_D: Set baby and juvenile sprite sizes according to their body mass.
LanguageData.Zoology_SexualDimorphism_Desc: Males and females of some species differ in body size and characteristics.
LanguageData.Zoology_OpenBurrow_Desc: Order a colonist to open this refuge. A mother may defend her den.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAdvancedReproduction_Desc: Birds build nests, marsupials carry young in pouches, and amphibians develop from roe through a tadpole stage.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAdvancedThreatAvoidance_De: Animals escape danger by taking refuge in trees, burrows or water where appropriate.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableWaterHabitatBehavior_Desc: Water-loving animals seek suitable water, while terrestrial animals return to dry ground.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableWinterDormancy_Desc: Wild animals of suitable species spend the winter in dormancy, often in burrows.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableAnimalFoodChoice_Desc: Animals choose food according to its accessibility and nutritional value, weighing hunting, fishing, plant harvesting and available food.
LanguageData.Zoology_EnableWildAnimalForage_Desc: Suitable hungry wild animals gather small portions of local food. Requires Odyssey and advanced food selection.
LanguageData.Zoology_BarnNoEdibleItems: No suitable food available on this map
